title: R′ Badan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin cites it as a sage’s name. Hyman says he has found it nowhere except [Rosh Hashanah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.25b.2), “Bedan in his generation is like Aaron in his generation,” where it refers to Samson, who came from Dan.[^1]

notes.text: [The preceding folio](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.25a.16) explains Bedan as Samson, from Dan. [Heilprin’s Badan entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=659&lang=en) discusses the sage’s name under two spellings and attributes it to the Arukh. Hyman attributes it to Yuchasin, whose passage was not checked here.
